verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Export API doc. It notes that users can delete messages from the Teams client, and that deleted messages stay retrievable via export APIs for 21 days. That confirms user-side deletion and a fixed post-deletion window, but says nothing about configurable retention. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or configurable retention periods, admin or user controls over deletion scope and permanent purge, programmatic deletion APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
